hypothesis: Bypassing L1 on the activation and residual loads improves the fixed-work throughput of the eight-warp fused residual RMSNorm on H100.

candidate.change: Use the Triton .cg load hint for activation and residual only.

codegen_gate.candidate_input_loads: four ld.global.cg instructions for activation and residual

timing.process_contract: Each period repeats all eight numerical fixtures and captured graph checks before timing; period two must reproduce the first period's input and weight fingerprints.
timing.measurement: 512 measured bursts after at least three seconds of warm-up; record wall and CUDA time for every burst and one period per submission.
timing.condition: Match shape, buffer layout, fingerprints and launch geometry for both backends.

adoption.metric: Median normalized rows per second per backend and seed.

motivation.finding: Warp remapping preserved both outputs and changed sustained throughput by less than 0.1% in seeds 206 and 207. Seed 206 fell short of the registered lower energy bound.
